notes: Pointer steps: zrender Handler mousemove / mouseout from outside the canvas; each 10 ms after the last; a frame of every chart after every step. A move's point: `data` through convertToPixel, rounded, or a point over a series item (`on`), then moved by `d`.
TooltipRichContent.getSize answers 80 x 40; box is the moveTo argument.
calls: per step, how many times each counting function ran (the frame after the step included).

cases.note: tooltip trigger none, the root axisPointer show true with snap and a label (scatter-nutrients-matrix): both axes collected, both snap, both labels shown, and the axis tooltip shows their rows
an item tooltip and the x axis' own show: the pointer on x alone, its rows in an axis tooltip over empty space; over a point the item tooltip wins
x: show with triggerTooltip false (no rows: a value axis that neither snaps nor triggers); y: show -- its rows alone in the box
a category axis' own show under a none tooltip: no snap, the rows of the category (involveSeries)
an axis tooltip (its x) and the y axis' own show: y collected first, then x; both in the box
two grids, the root show and link xAxisIndex all, a none tooltip: the hovered grid's axes and the other grid's linked x
no tooltip component: the root show draws both pointers, nothing else
show 'auto' on the axis, an item tooltip: not collected
the y axis' own show with a label template, a function label on x, a dashed red line, no tooltip trigger
a category axis' own shadow pointer, its label off, an item tooltip
an item tooltip with a function formatter, position and valueFormatter: each show calls each once
an item tooltip with a valueFormatter and a position, no formatter
an axis tooltip: the formatter only when the content changes, the position and the valueFormatter every show
an axis tooltip kept across a setOption: the keep timer shows it again, new values are new content
showDelay: the formatter and the position wait for the delay, a second move before it replaces the show
showDelay and a valueFormatter: the markup is built when the show is tried -- each move calls it, the delay does not

no tooltip, the x axis own pointer with a function label: BaseAxisPointer.render runs it when the value or the status changed, once more after the first show (the graphicKey change clears _lastValue), and on a full update (forceRender)
the same under a tooltip with trigger none: the axis tooltip header asks the label once per show besides

guards.what: trigger none and the root show: both axes shown, labels on
a move to the same content: the tooltip's own record forgot the last dataByCoordSys, the formatter runs
x alone, an axis tooltip over empty space
x does not trigger: y's rows alone
an item show: one call each
an axis show: the valueFormatter per row, the formatter each move
kept: new values call the formatter, the same ones only the position
the other grid's x is linked
